svg.title: A client with systemic lupus erythematosus who takes hydroxychloroquine calls the clinic to report new blurred vision. Which response by the nurse is correct?
svg.desc: Any visual change on hydroxychloroquine may be irreversible retinal toxicity , so the drug is stopped and the provider notified; routine eye exams are required. Waiting for the next visit is tempting because the symptom sounds mild, but retinal damage allowed to progress does not reverse.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Allergic, Inflammatory &
Immunologic Disorders
Read the situation
A client with systemic lupus erythematosus
who takes hydroxychloroquine calls the
clinic to report new blurred vision. Which
response by the nurse is correct?
What fits here
Stop the drug and call the provider today,
because vision changes can mean retinal
damage
Why it fits
Any visual change on hydroxychloroquine
may be irreversible retinal toxicity , so
the drug is stopped and the provider
notified; routine eye exams are required.
Waiting for the next visit is tempting
because the symptom sounds mild, but
retinal damage allowed to progress does
not reverse.
